title: Mixed Duo #011 · 남얼굴 아마조네스·피치 듀이 / 남 피트니스 모델·아이돌 내추럴
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright white-sand beach at midday with calm turquoise water, a wooden boardwalk with a waist-high rail and a row of closed striped cabanas of normal door height, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Turkish person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a clean-cut young male model face with defined cheekbones, a firm jaw and strong straight brows, a very faint trace of stubble, soft peach-pink eyeshadow, subtly glossy lips and a dewy highlight on the cheekbones, fair olive skin with a warm undertone, a relaxed half-smile, pure icy-white hair styled in elegant updo, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (an iron miniature anvil, a gold ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a gold hammer head, an iron ship's anchor, a gold small flared temple bell, a gold round bell, a gold miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum bracelets. Extremely long square nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad; a commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist; enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves; not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework), wide bold silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense lattice fills filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme black platform stiletto knee-high boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Iranian man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, natural idol makeup with soft brown eyeshadow and a tinted lip, olive skin with a warm undertone, a calm gentle gaze, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in low bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (an iron ship's anchor, a gold square-sided cowbell, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a lead pyramid-shaped lump, a bronze teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (an iron square-sided cowbell, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver teardrop-shaped sinker, a lead miniature anvil, a gold hammer head, a tin barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three platinum rings. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel (a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense cloisonné floral wirework filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme white platform loafers with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
